---
description: Generate an evidence-backed executive sprint brief.
---

Use the Executive Brief Agent.

1. Build a context envelope.
2. Retrieve the current sprint and approved roadmap context.
3. Add GitHub/ServiceNow evidence only when relevant.
4. Identify flow/validation exceptions.
5. Produce output matching `schemas/executive-brief.schema.json`.
6. Do not send or post the result. Return a draft for human review.
